people.name: Euphrates
people.line: Major river in ancient Near East; boundary of Promised Land

people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: There have also been mighty kings over Jerusalem, who have ruled over all the country beyond the River; and tribute, custom, and toll, was paid to them.
translations.bsb: And mighty kings have ruled over Jerusalem and exercised authority over the whole region west of the Euphrates; and tribute, duty, and toll were paid to them.
translations.kjv: There have been mighty kings also over Jerusalem, which have ruled over all countries beyond the river; and toll, tribute, and custom, was paid
